integrity: Complete finite code and outputs are embedded; finite checks are separated from the infinite saturation proof. Earlier binary and rank-three results are acknowledged rather than claimed anew.
scientific_limitations: Pure graph adjacency and equality; rank four only; arbitrary unequal-alphabet products and higher ranks not classified. Binary subfamily was previously classified. Historical-priority checks are incomplete; no independent audit or proof certification.
title: Sixteen four-round theories of Hamming graphs
